purpose: Define telemetry rules for detecting misconduct patterns, corruption indicators, operational anomalies, and systemic risks within municipal systems.

documentation_anomalies.description: Detects irregularities in municipal documentation, timestamps, and audit trails.

rules.name: Timestamp Inconsistency Rule
rules.trigger: Logs with missing, altered, or out-of-sequence timestamps.

rules.name: Missing Documentation Rule
rules.trigger: Required reports or logs absent from expected workflow.

rules.name: Unauthorized Edit Rule
rules.trigger: Edits made by actors without proper authority classification.

behavioral_patterns.description: Identifies repeated harmful municipal behaviors or misconduct patterns.

rules.name: Pattern-of-Practice Rule
rules.trigger: Three or more similar misconduct incidents within 90 days.

rules.name: Retaliatory Behavior Rule
rules.trigger: Actions targeting civilians following complaints or reports.

rules.name: Escalation Behavior Rule
rules.trigger: Repeated unnecessary escalation during municipal interactions.

corruption_indicators.description: Detects financial, relational, or procedural corruption signatures.

rules.name: Unusual Access Pattern Rule
rules.trigger: Repeated access to restricted systems without operational justification.

rules.name: Conflict-of-Interest Signature
rules.trigger: Behavior aligning with personal, financial, or political gain.

rules.name: Resource Misallocation Rule
rules.trigger: Municipal resources diverted from intended purpose.

rights_impact_indicators.description: Detects municipal actions that may violate civilian rights or constitutional protections.

rules.name: Rights Violation Risk Rule
rules.trigger: Telemetry detects behavior associated with rights infringement.

rules.name: Coercive Behavior Rule
rules.trigger: Use of coercive tactics in non-threatening situations.

systemic_risk_signatures.description: Identifies large-scale municipal failures or emerging systemic threats.

rules.name: Systemic Failure Pattern
rules.trigger: Multiple divisions reporting anomalies within a short timeframe.

rules.name: Operational Collapse Indicator
rules.trigger: Telemetry detects cascading failures across municipal systems.

rules.name: High-Risk Actor Signature
rules.trigger: Repeated high-severity alerts tied to a single municipal actor.
rules.action: Refer to Identity Kernel for authority review.

kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for pattern detection, risk scoring, and anomaly analysis.
kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor classification and authority verification.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for rights-impact evaluation and ethical risk scoring.
